title: PVL: Dij Rodriguez gets her shine in Creamline semis win

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Creamline found an unlikely hero in Dij Rodriguez, whose crucial play helped her team get back at sister team Choco Mucho and advance to the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series Finals. As a starter in the third set, Rodriguez held the fort for the Cool Smashers with eight points to eliminate Choco Mucho, 21-25, 25-17, 25-17, 25-23, in the semifinals on Tuesday at the Philsports Arena. With a loaded open spiker rotation composed of Jema Galanza, Bernadeth Pons, and Alyssa Valdez, coach Sherwin Meneses admitted that it takes a long process for others to get a chance to […]...
